observations: Photo 0 shows a light green industrial sewing machine on a workbench.
The machine has a blue label with 'SINGER Professional' and '20u33' clearly visible.
There are control knobs, a power switch, and a needle area with a presser foot.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear.
The background includes a red door, a yellow bag, and other workshop items.
No power cord, accessories, or manual are visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the machine, but there is no visual proof of usage history or condition beyond surface appearance. No signs of heavy wear or damage are visible, but 'barely used' is subjective and not verifiable from one photo.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photo.
risks.proof: Video or photo of the machine powered on, needle moving, and stitching fabric.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as power cord, foot pedal, or embroidery hoop.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out.

risks.risk: Machine may have hidden wear or damage to internal components (e.g., motor, gears, feed dogs).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the motor, gears, and feed mechanism in operation.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the machine in operation, stitching fabric.
Photo of all included accessories (power cord, foot pedal, etc.).
Close-up photos of the motor, gears, and feed mechanism.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
